build_training_input: build a training input iterator from a dataset config, masking rules, and token type ranges
build_eval_input: build an evaluation input iterator from a dataset config, masking rules, and token type ranges
build_training_update: build a JAX pmap training update function that computes gradients and applies optimizer steps
build_evaluator: build an evaluator function that runs a full evaluation epoch over the evaluation dataset
run_training_loop: run the main simultaneous train and eval loop with logging, checkpointing, and evaluation scheduling
